name: Draw Form (COMPAS CEM)
description: Draw a form diagram in color, with the forces as arrows and the edge forces as optional labels.

inputParameters.name: node_keys
inputParameters.description: A selection of the node keys in the diagram, which also selects the loads and reaction forces drawn. Defaults to all the node keys.

inputParameters.name: edge_keys
inputParameters.description: A selection of the edge keys in the diagram. Defaults to all the edge keys.

inputParameters.name: settings
inputParameters.description: The display settings from Form Display Settings. Defaults to its default settings.

outputParameters.name: nodes
outputParameters.description: The nodes of the diagram as points, white or green at a support. Bakes with their colors.

outputParameters.name: support_nodes
outputParameters.description: The support nodes of the diagram as green points. Bakes with their colors.

outputParameters.name: edges
outputParameters.description: The edges of the diagram as lines, red in tension and blue in compression, wider as their force grows. Bakes with their colors and plot weights.

outputParameters.name: loads
outputParameters.description: The applied loads as green arrows. Bakes as lines with their colors and plot weights; the arrowheads show in the viewport only.

outputParameters.name: reactions
outputParameters.description: The reaction forces at the supports as gray arrows. Bakes as lines with their colors and plot weights; the arrowheads show in the viewport only.
